payload.summary: tier recorded as SEED, not standard: the complete standard-tier artifact set was drafted and recorded (constitution with the paragraph verbatim, glossary, three founding ADRs, governance, merge authority, routing map, dispatch config, run contract, and a seven-item decomposition), but the cross-vendor elaboration verification returned verdict=disagree (event 8tzhmcwz, agent:codex). nahel/workflows/inception.md is explicit that a disagreeing verification leaves the founding at seed or parked and never at standard, so standard was refused despite the work being done. The founding instruction asked for standard; the workflow wins. Consequence to expect: the tier ratchet means delegated product approval and prototype promotion are unavailable until an inception upgrade re-runs at standard with a passing verification.
